notes.title: Sept. 23rd QOL Update - Better Peace Deals (War Exhaustion + Pop Loss Tracking)
notes.notes:
AI nations will now make better and faster peace deals depending on war exhaustion from pop losses and other factors

Improvements for Planetary Resource Amounts Demanded from Industrial Inputs

Tooltip Improvements + more information for Planetary Industries

Camera moves faster with shift

notes.title: Sept. 5th Content Update - Stockpile Automation
notes.notes: Added fully automated stockpile automation with buy/sell, amount & price limits - which can be set up for any stockpile on any planet market.

notes.title: July 30th Hotfix Updates Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed % of cargo from stockpile so that it uses fleet cargo max correctly
Fixed rare case of speed modifications occurring mid install

notes.title: July 26 QOL Update Notes
notes.notes:
Added more clear notifications for mission completions win or lose
Fixed automation stockpile bug where cargo amounts could be exceeded under specific circumstances

notes.title: July 23 Hotfix Update Notes
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where non-combat mission initialization under specific circumstances would freeze the game.

notes.title: July 22 Hotfix Update Notes
notes.notes:
Transferring/considering transferring components from a fleet into a stockpile during installation now works without freezing up GUI window and properly cancels installation on a transfer

Decreased average prices of certain fleet components

notes.title: Auto-pause on Manual Fleet Arrivals (Optional)
notes.notes: Player fleets pause the game when they have a final arrival. This can be disabled on a per fleet basis in the fleets detail screen.

notes.title: July 8th QOL Update Notes
notes.notes:
Added more tooltips for various hotkeys and mouse keybinds
Scroll speed adjustment in options menu

notes.title: Windowed Fullscreen Toggle
notes.notes: F11 or Options menu to change from fullscreen to windowed mode

notes.title: Volume Adjustment + Slider Audio Change
notes.notes:
Volume can now be changed in options
Slider audio made less repetitive

notes.title: Zoom to Cursor + Discord Link Corrected
notes.notes:
Zoom now goes to cursor position
Discord link works again correctly

notes.title: Flashing Red + Larger Notifications
notes.notes: Notifications are now visually larger and blocking notifs flash red to help draw attention to themselves

notes.title: Quick Trade from Planet Screen & Auto Stop Turns on Arrival
notes.notes:
Quick buy or sell from planet overview cheap or expensive resources for faster trading
Auto stop can be enabled per fleet to stop turns from ticking when a fleet arrives at its final destination

notes.title: Fixed Fleet Docking Animation in Play Mode
notes.notes:
Fleets properly dock when done moving in play mode
Fleets no longer reset movement on turn tick when docking or beginning move
Added tooltips to in-world resource gui

notes.title: In World Plentiful/Expensive Resource Displays
notes.notes:
Toggleable Resource Displays around all Planets for faster perception of cheap/expensive resources
Tutorial trading made easier
Tutorial highlight now fades in and out slighty
Small Wiki Fix

notes.title: Warning for no Operations Mode Component + Improved Tutorial Layout
notes.notes:
Warning for no ops mode if that occurs from uninstalling critical components
Fixed turns ticking past game over
Fixed past games monetary history carrying over to new game
Better layout for tutorial frame positioning

notes.title: More hotkeys for planet overview actions and bottom hud row
notes.notes:
Planet overview actions triggered with T, B, M
Bottom hud row with f1-f7

notes.title: Planetary Stockpiles
notes.notes: Added the ability to create local planetary stockpiles on friendly nations planets. They can be created from the planetary overview screen with a fleet in orbit and then accessed by swapping the dropdowns in the trade screen. You can also directly trade from a stockpile to the planetary market even with no fleet in orbit. But be careful, if your relations with the "host" nation drop below the hostile/embargo level the owning nation will seize your stockpile and all resources within it...

notes.title: Spacebar to Play/Pause + Small Animation Tweaks
notes.notes:
Spacebar now pauses and plays
Better animation for transition from single turn presses to playing and vice versa
